data.body: Execution-plan correction: the immutable 0033662b5534531d84e39d4a14bf75c8e768e85e comparison failed only for _cloud_mutation_support.py because merged commit 88c90f8b5abf4a80be3b1289d7719d6e03e29684 changed its executable engine-path imports after that base. The current leaf base 665d1d0480187380f82e59bd95af1f0c44274732 contains that refactor and has the same three target blobs as the prior signed-review snapshot 12a10f3ab4effc1fbad58f47c1dab80e34f07744. Corrected the description and immutable AST command to 665d1d; also aligned local verification with the operator's documentation-only policy (focused checks plus lint/typecheck, full suite in Gerrit CI). A fresh plan review is required before implementation resumes.
